synFindEntityId

synFindEntityId.Rd

Find an Entity given its name and parent.

Usage

synFindEntityId(name, parent=NULL, synapse_client=NULL)

Arguments

name

(str) Name of the entity to find.

parent

(Optional[Union[str, Dataset, DatasetCollection, EntityView, File, Folder, Link, MaterializedView, Project, RecordSet, SubmissionView, Table, VirtualTable]]) An Entity object (Dataset, DatasetCollection, EntityView, File, Folder, Link, MaterializedView, Project, RecordSet, SubmissionView, Table, VirtualTable) or the Id of an entity as a string. Omit if searching for a Project by name.

synapse_client

(Optional[Synapse]) If not passed in, the last created instance from the Synapse class constructor will be used.

Value

The Entity ID or NULL if not found.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
## Example 1: Finding a project by name
    # Find a project using only its name:
    library(synapser)
    synLogin()

    project_id = synFindEntityId(name = "My Project")
    if (!is.null(project_id)) {
        print(sprintf("Found project: %s", project_id))
    } else {
        print("Project not found")
    }

## Example 2: Finding an entity within a parent
    # Find a file within a specific folder:
    library(synapser)
    synLogin()

    file_id = synFindEntityId(
        name = "my_data.csv",
        parent = "syn123456" # Parent folder ID
    )
    if (!is.null(file_id)) {
        print(sprintf("Found file: %s", file_id))
    } else {
        print("File not found in folder")
    }

## Example 3: Using with entity objects
    # Find an entity using an entity object as the parent:
    library(synapser)
    synLogin()

    parent_folder = Folder(id = "syn123456")
    entity_id = synFindEntityId(
        name = "analysis_results.txt",
        parent = parent_folder
    )
    print(sprintf("Entity ID: %s", entity_id))
} # }
